verdict.rationale: First-party docs show extensive in-product AI insights and suggestions drawn from the user's own data. These include Copilot natural-language queries over forecasts and team metrics, AI-generated opportunity summaries and meeting prep notes, predictive lead and opportunity scoring, AI-powered alerts, call summaries with suggested tasks, and agents that flag risks and next best actions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Get insights into forecasts and team metrics like conversion and win rates by querying Copilot using natural language or prebuilt prompts.
View AI-generated opportunity summaries and meeting preparation notes including customer status, relevant news, and past meeting notes.
Copilot-generated email drafts and call summaries that include an analysis of sales KPIs and suggested tasks.
using AI to prioritize leads and opportunities using predictive lead and opportunity scoring and predictive forecasting
helps you close complex deals by spotting risks early, highlighting top opportunities
